name: facebook
description: facebook.com's own GraphQL requests, learned from its web pages in November 2026. Signed in with the cookies of a Facebook login (c_user, xs). Each request carries the session's fb_dtsg, which facebook.com hands out as JSON at /ajax/dtsg/; `av` is who acts: the login itself or a Page's profile (Pages in Facebook's profile-based experience). Reels go through Meta Business Suite's own requests (business.facebook.com, same login): its music library's search, its video upload and its reel Share, where Facebook adds the sound itself.

operations.name: me
operations.description: The signed-in login itself: its profile id, name and picture.

operations.name: profiles
operations.description: The login's own profile and every Page profile it can switch to and act as (the account menu's profile switcher).

operations.name: pageId
operations.description: A Page's classic Page id (the one Business Suite and the Graph API use), from its facebook.com profile page (delegate_page_id). Read once at sign-in, to tell that two connectors reach the same Page.

operations.name: posts
operations.description: The latest posts of a profile or Page (its timeline), newest first: id, time, text, link and media. The answer streams one JSON value per line (GraphQL @stream/@defer), put back together.

operations.name: uploadPhoto
operations.description: Uploads a picture for a post (not yet attached to anything): its photoID goes into createPost. Learned with the request aborted; not verified with a real send yet. As a Page: av and __user are the Page's profile id and the session carries the i_user cookie (the Page acted as), as facebook.com sends them after switching to the Page.

params.name: path
params.description: The picture to upload (a file in Greenlit's data folder)

operations.name: createPost
operations.description: Publishes a post as the actor (the login or a Page profile): text, audience (base_state EVERYONE / FRIENDS / SELF = only me) and attachments ([{photo: {id}}] from uploadPhoto). Learned with the request aborted; not verified with a real send yet. As a Page: av and __user are the Page's profile id and the session carries the i_user cookie (the Page acted as), as facebook.com sends them after switching to the Page.

params.name: token
params.description: A new <uuid>_FEED for each post (the composer's idempotence token)

params.name: placeId
params.description: The post's place (a Page id from placeSearch); empty for none

params.name: placeShow
params.description: SHOW_ATTACHMENT with a place, as the composer sends it; empty for none

operations.name: deletePost
operations.description: Deletes a post of the profile or Page acted as (facebook.com's own "Delete post"). The story id is base64 of S:_I<actor>:<post id>:<post id> for feed posts. Learned with the request aborted (Nov 2026), not sent yet. As a Page: av and __user are the Page's profile id and the session carries the i_user cookie.

params.name: storyId
params.description: The story's id: base64 of S:_I<actor>:<post id>:<post id>

operations.name: schedulePost
operations.description: A post Facebook publishes later by itself (the composer's Schedule post): createPost plus unpublished_content_data {scheduled_publish_time, SCHEDULED}. Hidden until then. Learned with the request aborted (Nov 2026), not sent yet. As a Page: av and __user are the Page's profile id and the session carries the i_user cookie.

params.name: token
params.description: A new <uuid>_FEED for each post (the composer's idempotence token)

params.name: publishAt
params.description: When Facebook publishes it (Unix seconds)

params.name: placeId
params.description: The post's place (a Page id from placeSearch); empty for none

params.name: placeShow
params.description: SHOW_ATTACHMENT with a place, as the composer sends it; empty for none

operations.name: draftPost
operations.description: A draft (the composer's Save as draft): createPost plus unpublished_content_data {null, DRAFT}; only the Page's people see it. Learned with the request aborted (Nov 2026), not sent yet. As a Page: av and __user are the Page's profile id and the session carries the i_user cookie.

params.name: token
params.description: A new <uuid>_FEED for each post (the composer's idempotence token)

operations.name: musicSearch
operations.description: Meta's music library for a Page's reel, as Business Suite's reel composer searches it (ReelComposerAudioSearchResultsContainerFBQuery, as the Page): each sound's asset id, title, artist, cover, the whole track (progressive_download) and its length; its tags' names are the track's suggested starts in ms. Tracks are the ones available for business use.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

operations.name: videoUploadStart
operations.description: Starts a reel's video upload as Business Suite does (ajax/video/upload/requests/start/, for the Page): the file's size. Answers the video's id and the upload session's; the bytes then go with videoUploadBytes, then videoUploadReceive. An upload makes no post.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

params.name: waterfallId
params.description: The upload's id (a UUID), the same for its three steps

operations.name: videoUploadBytes
operations.description: Sends the reel's video to Facebook's upload service in one piece (rupload.facebook.com/fb_video/<name>), for the upload videoUploadStart began. Answers the handle videoUploadReceive passes on.

params.name: path
params.description: The reel's video (a file in Greenlit's data folder)

operations.name: videoUploadReceive
operations.description: Finishes the reel's video upload as Business Suite does (ajax/video/upload/requests/receive/): the handle the upload service answered, for the whole file. The video can then be published with createReel.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

params.name: handle
params.description: videoUploadBytes' answer

operations.name: createReel
operations.description: Publishes an uploaded video as the Page's reel, as Business Suite's reel composer Shares it (BusinessComposerStoryCreationMutation, Facebook only): the text, the cover, and the edits Facebook renders itself — a sound from the library (music_overlay: its asset, where in the track it starts and for how long, in seconds; left out for none) and both volumes (audio_mixing, 0 to 1). Its place, when it has one, is explicit_place_id (a Page id from placeSearch).

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

params.name: identities
params.description: Who posts: the Page's id

params.name: music
params.description: The sound: {"id": its asset id, "offset": where in the track it starts (s), "duration": how long it plays (s)}; leave out for none

params.name: placeId
params.description: The reel's place (a Page id from placeSearch); empty for none, as the composer sends it

operations.name: createStory
operations.description: Shares a picture to a Page's story, as Business Suite's story composer does (BusinessComposerStoryCreationMutation, the same GraphQL document as a reel's), as the Page (`av` its classic id, the login's session): the picture is uploaded first (uploadPhoto, as the Page) and named here. Shared to the Facebook story only (channels: FACEBOOK_STORY); the composer's default also shares to the linked Instagram account, which Greenlit leaves out.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

params.name: identities
params.description: Who posts: the Page's id

params.name: photoId
params.description: The uploaded picture

operations.name: placeSearch
operations.description: Places for a post's "Check in", as facebook.com's composer searches them (useComposerLocationPickerTypeaheadDataSourceQuery): each place's Page id (the post's explicit_place_id), its name, and whether it is a city-like place (geohub).

operations.name: encodeVideo
operations.description: Asks Facebook to encode an uploaded video for the composer, as Business Suite's story composer does once the upload is received (BusinessComposerVideoEncodingTriggerMutation, as the Page). It makes no post: the story's Share is ready once the video is encoded.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

operations.name: createVideoStory
operations.description: Shares an uploaded video to a Page's story, as Business Suite's story composer does (BusinessComposerStoryCreationMutation, Facebook story only): createStory's Share with the video as the attachment. The video goes up first (videoUploadStart, videoUploadBytes, videoUploadReceive) and is encoded (encodeVideo).

params.name: pageId
params.description: The Page's id (its classic id, as Business Suite's asset_id)

params.name: identities
params.description: Who posts: the Page's id

params.name: videoId
params.description: The uploaded video

operations.name: plannerToken
operations.description: The access token Business Suite's planner uses, as its settings page embeds it for itself (a plain GET of the page with the login's session; the token is read from the page's HTML and kept in memory only). It is the person's token: Graph calls made with it act as the login.

operations.name: pageToken
operations.description: A Page's own access token, as Business Suite reads it with its planner token (Graph GET /<page>?fields=access_token): what Graph calls made as the Page carry. Kept in memory only. Sent with the login's session cookies, as Business Suite's own Graph calls are (its token is tied to that session).

params.name: token
params.description: The planner token (plannerToken)

operations.name: pageComment
operations.description: Posts a comment under a Page's post as the Page, as Business Suite replies to comments (Graph POST /<page>_<post>/comments with the Page's token; a reel Facebook named no post for: its video). Sent with the login's session cookies, as Business Suite's own Graph calls are (its token is tied to that session).

params.name: target
params.description: The post (<page>_<post>) or a reel's video id

params.name: token
params.description: The Page's token (pageToken)
